post.description: The storefront's contact form. A name, an email and a message are required; a subject, a phone and an order number are welcome. `website` is a honeypot — a field no person sees — and a filled one is accepted and dropped. One address may send ten messages and enquiries a minute between them by default (the connection's peer address, never X-Forwarded-For); past that the answer is 429 with Retry-After. The operator is told by email at the address the Plugins screen holds, and that announcement lands in Notifications. 404 while the plugin is off.

post.summary: Ask the store about a product
post.description: A product page's enquiry form. Name the product by `product_id` or `product_slug` (both must agree when both are sent); only a product on sale can be asked about, and a draft or archived one is refused as if it did not exist. `variant_id` narrows it to one of the product's variants and `quantity` says how many the shopper has in mind. The enquiry lands in the same inbox as the contact form's messages, marked `kind: enquiry` and carrying the product as it is called now, and is announced to the same address with the `contact.enquiry` email. Limited per address together with the contact form, with the same honeypot. 404 while the plugin is off or its `enquiries` setting is.

get.description: Messages and product enquiries, newest first, without their threads. Needs contact.read. Where personal data is masked (a demo store, an agent key) the addresses come back masked and `q` does not match them.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: The contact form's messages, or product enquiries. Absent means both.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A name, email, subject or product-name fragment, or an order number.

patch.summary: Mark a message replied or archived, or note something on it
patch.description: For a message answered somewhere else — by phone, or from the operator's own mail — and for notes. Replying from the panel marks it replied by itself. Needs contact.write.

delete.description: The message and its replies. Needs contact.write.

post.summary: Reply to a message by email
post.description: Sends the reply to the shopper now, with the `contact.reply` email, through the store's email provider — from its sender, with its reply-to address, so the answer comes back to the shop. Once the provider has taken it, the reply joins the message's thread with who sent it, and the message is marked replied, in one transaction. A reply that did not go is not recorded and the message is left as it was: 409 when the store has no email provider that delivers, 422 when the provider refused it (with the provider's reason) or could not be reached; every attempt is on the Notifications screen. An empty subject is "Re: " and the message's subject, or the product's name on an enquiry. 403 `demo_frozen` on a public demo, which sends no replies. Needs contact.reply.

201.description: Sent and recorded: the message, with its thread.

422.description: The email provider refused the reply (`provider_refused`, with its reason) or could not be reached (`provider_unreachable`). Nothing was recorded.

ContactTooMany.description: This address has sent its messages for the minute (`too_many_attempts`). Retry-After says how many seconds until it may send again.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the address's minute ends.

phone.description: Digits, spaces and + - ( ) . only, at least five digits.

product_id.description: The product, or name it by product_slug.

phone.description: Digits, spaces and + - ( ) . only, at least five digits.

subject.description: Empty means "Re: " and the message's own.

ContactEnquiryProduct.description: What an enquiry was about, as the product was called when the shopper asked.

variant_title.description: The variant's options, or its SKU when it has none.

sent_by.description: The operator's address, "api key: …" for a key, or "token" for the static admin token. Masked where addresses are.

notes.description: The operator's own, never shown to the shopper.

replies.description: The thread, oldest first; on a single message only.
